p: son heard that Abner was dead: That is, Ishbosheth.
feeble: Meaning, that he was discouraged.
Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin: This city Beeroth was in the tribe of Benjamin, Jos 18:25.
Gittaim: After the death of Saul, for fear of the Philistines.
would have fetched wheat: They disguised themselves as merchants, who came to buy wheat.
smote him under the fifth rib: There is nothing so vile and dangerous, which the wicked will not undertake in hope of money and favour.

much more: In that neither the example of him that slew Saul, nor duty to their master, nor the innocency of the person, nor reverence for the place, nor time moved them, they deserved most grievous punishment.
